# jumpcloud_policy_group_membership (Resource)

Manages membership of a policy in a JumpCloud policy group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_policy_group_membership" "example" {
  group_id  = jumpcloud_policy_group.compliance.id
  policy_id = jumpcloud_policy.filevault.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the policy group.
- `policy_id` (String) The ID of the policy to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format group_id/policy_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_policy_group_membership.example <group-id>/<policy-id>
```
